title: Robotics Technician — Career Roadmap
summary: A Robotics Technician installs, operates, tests and maintains robotic systems used in manufacturing, warehouses, laboratories and other automated environments. The role includes robot setup, sensor integration, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance and support for robotic programming.

blocks.label: Recommended route
blocks.text: Class 10 followed by a relevant engineering diploma; Science with Mathematics is useful for alternative routes.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Physics, basic electronics, mechanical systems and Computer Applications.

blocks.label: Entrance exams
blocks.text: State polytechnic entrance tests, such as AP POLYCET for applicable Andhra Pradesh admissions; verify current notifications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Industrial robots, robotic arms, sensors, motors, PLCs and automated production lines.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Logical reasoning, spatial awareness, troubleshooting, basic coding and workshop safety.

items.text: Diploma in Robotics / Automation Engineering → Robot operation, industrial automation and robotic-cell maintenance.
Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering → Mechanical, electrical, electronic and control-system integration.
Diploma in Instrumentation & Control Engineering → Sensors, actuators, control systems and robot feedback.
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering → Robot mechanisms, fixtures, maintenance and motion systems.
Diploma in Electronics Engineering → Robot controllers, sensors, wiring and electronic troubleshooting.

blocks.text: Prioritise programmes with hands-on robotic arms, PLCs, drives, sensors and industrial maintenance laboratories.

blocks.text: Industrial robot programming, collaborative robots, machine vision, robotic maintenance, PLC integration, autonomous mobile robots and robotic safety.
An engineering degree is not typically required for entry-level technician work.
